FULL TEXT:
PATNA HIGH COURT
NOTICE
District Judge (Entry Level), Direct from Bar Exam-2026
In view of several representations received from the candidates/ aspirants of
District Judge (Entry Level), Direct from Bar Exam-2026 who have already applied/
registered online for the said exam in response to the Advertisement No. BSJS/1/2026
dated 30.03.2026 but have some issue regarding payment of examination fee, as
decided it is hereby informed that the online portal of the Patna High Court for receiving
application for the aforesaid exam is extended by ten (1 0) days i.e. upto 25.05.2026 till
23:59 hours from 15.05.2026 onwards. However, the link shall remain available upto
01.06.2026 till 23:59 hours only for the purpose of uploading the scanned photograph,
signature, declaration written in the own handwriting, filling bank reference number and
obtaining printout of the online filled application form.
Further, it is made clear that the candidates are liable to pay the requisite fee
again, if wrong/ invalid credential (viz. Registration Number, date of birth and etc.) has
been mentioned/ given by them C:lt the lime of submission of examination fee resulting in
showing the fee as not paid.
Patna High Court, Patna
Date: 14.05.2026
By order of the Court
Registrar General
